vision.name: Gotenks
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks are considered Styled and gain "HIT: Destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck."
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
If stopped, search your Life Deck for a Named card and place it into your hand.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
HIT: Destroy the top card of each player's Life Deck. Banish the top 5 cards of your opponent's discard pile.
vision.note: full-art promo (Japanese name art); edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badges S, E, F; stats and text compared against S13_BST_55 on the sheet, identical; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
